  Principles of soft computing [CSE-4305]  
  Marks: 50                                                                                 Duration: 180 mins.  
  PART-A  
  Answer all the questions.  
  1)           Distinguish between Supervised and Unsupervised learning algorithm.  
  (2)  
  A)  
  B)      A single input, single output neuron has a weight of 5 and a bias of -3. What is the net  
  input to the transfer function if it is given an input of 1? What will be the output if the    (3)  
  transfer function is sigmoid activation function?  
  
  C)      Explain Error correction learning method in detail with suitable example.                      (5)  
  2)           Explain and draw the architecture of a Convolutional Neural networks and explain its  
  operation in terms of each layer.  
  (5)  
  A)  
  B)      Explain Gradient descent algorithm in detailed steps with suitable example.                    (5)  
  3)           Draw the architecture of Associative memory network architecture and explain its  
  operation. Mention its advantages and applications.  
  (5)  
  A)  
  B)      Explain operation involved in Kohonen network. Suppose, for instance that the 2-  
  dimensional input vector X is presented to the three-neuron Kohonen network and W1,  
  W2 and W3 are initial weight vectors. Find the winning neuron and updated weights:             (5)  
  $$X = [0.52, 0.12], W1= [0.27, 0.81], W2 = [0.42, 0.70], W3 = [0.43, 0.21].$$  
  
  4)           Distinguish between Crisp set and Fuzzy set.  
  (2)  
  A)  
  B)      Illustrate different fuzzy membership functions used in fuzzy logic.                           (3)  
  C)      Design a fuzzy based model for automation of Anti-lock braking system. Mention input  
  profiles, output profiles and rules.                                                 (5)
